_comment: The configuration that produced every number in the paper. Each phase script reads its values from the command line; these are the executed defaults, listed here so a reproduction can be checked against them without reading the code.

seeds.note: Seed 42 carries the full grid. Seeds 1 and 2 repeat training and evaluation end to end, so the reported spread is training-seed spread, not decoding noise.

phase_a_offline_preparation.index: FAISS IndexFlatIP over L2-normalised embeddings (cosine similarity)
phase_a_offline_preparation.question_type_assignment: deterministic regular expressions over the question stem
phase_a_offline_preparation.entity_extraction: scispaCy en_ner_bc5cdr_md when importable, otherwise phrase matching against the stored BC5CDR vocabulary

phase_b_prompt_and_adaptation.truncation_side_note: 'left' keeps the end of the prompt so the target question survives the cap. The submitted runs used 'right', which dropped it; both are reproducible via --truncation_side.

phase_c_inference_and_selection.decoding: beam search, num_beams = n_candidates, do_sample false, early_stopping true
phase_c_inference_and_selection.entity_bonus_target_set: entities of the question, E(q), capped at 12

evaluation.reference: original dataset answer, never the machine summary
evaluation.bootstrap: percentile, paired on the same questions for differences
evaluation.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm, over the five metrics of a family
evaluation.interpretation_rule: a difference counts as an effect only when its interval excludes zero and it exceeds the seed-to-seed standard deviation
